cohort: 1303 exclusively breast-fed infants from 3 months of age
finding: Specific gut microbiota characteristics of samples from 3-month-old breast-fed infants were associated with cesarean birth, and greater Clostridium sensu stricto abundance was associated with atopic dermatitis.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with specific gut microbiota characteristics in 3-month-old breast-fed infants.
